sense: a variant the style rules out
definition: Wrong for this style: one option of a slot that the style rules out, with a note saying why. The element stays in use; only this way of making it is refused, as a Georgian roof refuses a cross gable.
basis: schema/kit.schema.json, on a variant's status: "forbidden: wrong, and the note should say why." and on a slot's variants: "Most of what a style says about a slot is which options it REFUSES". kits/georgian-colonial-american.kit.json roof_form.variants[cross-gable].note: "Breaks the single unaccented cornice line the whole composition depends on."
